Behind the Lens

"I love creating. It's my whole life."

Joining the WVU Army ROTC gave Ayden Norcross access to a WVU education that would help him fulfill his documentarian dreams. He’s photographed European soldiers in Germany, Peruvian soldiers on parade, troops in the heat of competition, and families saying goodbye to departing soldiers.

See how he found his path at WVU and how you can find yours in one of our 300+ programs.
